title: Phepo e e sa Lebelelwang ya Mogolwane
intro: Mo lefelong le le boitshepo la Ntlo ya ga Allah, motlhanka mongwe wa Modimo yo o godileng o ne a itemogela masaitsiweng a a tseneletseng a a neng a sa lebelele sepe. Motho yono yo o ineetseng, yo o sa bolong go feta dingwaga tsa botsadi jwa tlholego, o ne a bona sengwe se se sa tlwaelegang se se neng se senola kutlwelobotlhoko e e senang selekanyo ya Bomodimo. Thadi e mo go ribololeng motsotso o o lebetsweng o go tswa mo matshelong a baporofeti.
clues: Batho ba me ba ne ba itsege e le Iseraele, ditlogolwana tsa tlhogo ya lotso e kgolo ya bogologolo.
Ke ne ke fetsa masigo a me ke rapela, ke khubama fa pele ga Morena wa me mo tempeleng.
Ke ne ka newa morwa mo botsofeng jwa me, mpho e ke neng ke sa kgaotse go e galaletsa Allah.
Teko ya me e ne e akaretsa go ribolola phepo e e neng e tlhagelela mo moweng o monnye o o neng o le kafa tlase ga tlhokomelo ya me.
Ke ne ke le moporofeti yo o bidiwang Zakariyya, yo o neng a neilwe tiro ya go tlhokomela Maryam kwa Bayt al-Maqdis.
Karabo e mo temaneng e mo go yone Allah a neng a amogela Maryam mme a mo naya dijo.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
